question: How many cities of the host state hosted the National Games 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **5 cities** of the host state Goa hosted the National Games 2023.
 
• The** 2023 National Games**, the 37th edition, were hosted in five cities of** Goa**: **Panaji, Margao, Vasco da Gama, Mapusa, and Ponda.**
 
• The National Games were spread across multiple venues to ensure better infrastructure utilization and to promote sports across different regions.
 
• Hosting the games in multiple cities helps in the development of sports facilities and encourages local talent to participate and compete.
 
• The cities were chosen based on their available infrastructure and capacity to host various sporting events.
 
• The National Games serve as a platform to identify and nurture talent for international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Games are held every four years, and the 2023 edition was a significant event for the host state.
 
• The event saw participation from athletes across the country, competing in various disciplines.
 
• Organizing the games involved coordination between multiple state and central agencies to ensure smooth conduct.
 
• The National Games help in promoting sports culture and identifying future stars for the country.
 
• Hosting the games also provides a boost to the local economy through tourism and related activities.
